name: Social Engine
author: Jordy Meow

sections.description:
Social Engine is the self-hosted social media scheduler for WordPress. Connect directly to X (Twitter), Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and Mastodon—no middleman, no monthly fees, complete control.

Unlike Buffer, Hootsuite, or Later, Social Engine runs entirely on your WordPress site. Your data stays yours, your connections are permanent, and there’s no monthly subscription. Set it up once (15-30 minutes per platform), then enjoy unlimited scheduling forever.

Stop paying for features you already own! 🚀

Social Engine implements full MCP support for AI-powered social media automation. Visit our official site and check out the docs to get started.

Core Modules

📅 Smart Scheduling
Visual calendar with drag-and-drop, per-account posting times, and intelligent queue management. Schedule weeks ahead or let AI handle it.

🤖 AI-Powered Enhancement
Built-in AI Post Enhancer rewrites content naturally, suggests hashtags, and maintains your brand voice. Works with AI Engine for advanced features.

🌍 Multi-Language Support
Full Polylang and WPML integration. Filter by language, auto-schedule per locale, maintain tone across translations.

🧠 Intelligence Features
Full MCP support means AI assistants like ChatGPT or Claude can schedule posts, manage your queue, and create content—all through conversation.

📅 Smart Scheduling

Control when and how your content reaches social networks.

Calendar View:

  • Beautiful drag-and-drop interface
  • Month, week, or list view
  • Color-coded by platform
  • Quick post editing
  • Bulk operations

Auto-Scheduling:

  • Automatically post new WordPress content
  • Filter by post type, tag, or language
  • Customizable templates with variables
  • Featured image support
  • Smart timing based on your schedule

Queue Management:

  • Per-account default posting times
  • Multiple time slots per day
  • Smart slot detection (avoids conflicts)
  • Draft workflow for review
  • Locked dates to prevent scheduling

🤖 AI-Powered Enhancement

Let AI perfect your social content before it goes live.

Post Enhancer:

  • Rewrites content naturally for each platform
  • Suggests relevant hashtags
  • Maintains your brand voice and language
  • Quick Test mode to preview changes
  • Works with all supported languages

AI Vision (requires AI Engine):

  • Analyzes images and suggests captions
  • Describes product photos automatically
  • Creates alt text for accessibility
  • Multi-image gallery support

🌍 Multi-Language Support

Perfect for multilingual sites using Polylang or WPML.

Features:

  • Filter posts by language in calendar
  • Auto-schedule only specific languages
  • AI Enhancer respects original language
  • Template variables work per locale
  • Separate queues per language

🧠 Intelligence Features

Social Engine has full MCP (Model Context Protocol) support, so AI assistants can manage your entire social media workflow through conversation.

What AI Can Do:

  • “Schedule my latest post to Twitter tomorrow at 3pm”
  • “Show me what’s in the queue for next week”
  • “Rewrite this post for Instagram and add hashtags”
  • “Delete all draft posts older than 30 days”
  • “Publish this content to all my accounts now”
  • “Create 5 posts from my recent articles”

Setup Guide:

Check the MCP documentation to connect ChatGPT or Claude to your WordPress site. Social Engine’s tools will appear automatically alongside AI Engine’s core features.

Automation Examples:

  • Daily content generation from blog posts
  • Automated hashtag research
  • Bulk post creation from content calendar
  • Smart scheduling based on engagement patterns
  • Multi-platform content adaptation

🔌 Platform Support

Direct connections to major social networks.

Supported Platforms:

  • X (Twitter): Text, images, polls (via API v2)
  • Facebook: Posts, images, links with previews
  • Instagram: Images, galleries, captions
  • LinkedIn: Professional content, images
  • Pinterest: Pins with images and descriptions
  • Mastodon: Federated network support

Connection Method:

Unlike third-party schedulers, Social Engine uses your own app credentials. This means:

  • No data sharing with intermediaries
  • No rate limits from scheduling services
  • Permanent access (not subject to service changes)
  • Full API feature support
  • Complete privacy

Setup takes 15-30 minutes per platform (one-time), then you’re independent forever.

Pro Features

  • Instagram Support
  • Pinterest Support
  • LinkedIn Support
  • Revive Posts (auto-repost old content)
  • Draft Workflow
  • Priority Support
sections.installation:
1. Upload social-engine to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Visit Social Engine in your admin menu
  4. Connect your first social network (follow the setup wizard)
  5. Start scheduling! 🚀

For AI features, install AI Engine.

For MCP support, follow the MCP setup guide.
sections.faq:
How is this different from Buffer or Hootsuite?

Social Engine runs on YOUR WordPress site, not on external servers. You connect directly to social networks using your own app credentials. This means:

  • No monthly subscription fees
  • Your data stays private on your server
  • No rate limits from third-party services
  • Permanent access (not subject to service shutdowns or price changes)

The tradeoff: initial setup takes 15-30 minutes per platform. After that, you’re completely independent.

Do I need technical skills to set this up?

The setup is detailed but straightforward. You’ll need to:

  1. Create a developer account on each platform (free)
  2. Register an “app” (just filling out forms)
  3. Copy API credentials into Social Engine
  4. Authenticate once

We provide step-by-step tutorials with screenshots for each platform.

Can I schedule to multiple accounts on the same platform?

Yes! Connect multiple Twitter accounts, Facebook pages, Instagram profiles, etc. Each gets its own queue and posting times.

How does the AI Post Enhancer work?

The AI Enhancer (requires AI Engine) rewrites your content to be more engaging while maintaining your voice. It:

  • Adapts tone for each platform
  • Suggests relevant hashtags
  • Keeps your original language
  • Works with images (vision AI)
  • Provides Quick Test mode to preview changes

Does this work with Polylang or WPML?

Yes! Social Engine has full multilingual support:

  • Filter calendar by language
  • Auto-schedule only specific languages
  • AI respects original language in enhancements
  • Separate queues per language

What’s MCP and why should I care?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI assistants like ChatGPT or Claude manage your social media through conversation. Instead of clicking through the UI, you can say:

“Schedule my latest 5 posts to Twitter, one per day at 2pm”
“Show me what’s queued for next week”
“Rewrite this for Instagram with hashtags”

It’s like having a social media manager you can talk to naturally.

Can I import content from Buffer or Hootsuite?

Not directly, but you can:

  1. Export your scheduled posts from the other service
  2. Use Social Engine’s template system to recreate them
  3. Or use AI Engine with MCP to bulk-create posts from your content

Is my social media data secure?

Yes. Everything runs on your WordPress server:

  • API credentials stored in your database
  • No data sent to external scheduling services
  • Direct connections to social networks
  • You control backups and security

What happens if I stop using WordPress?

Your social media accounts remain connected through your app credentials. You can:

  • Use those same credentials with other tools
  • Keep scheduling manually through each platform
  • Export your content before migrating

The connections are yours, permanently.
